faqs.question: How do I order a cake from Sabu Cakes?
faqs.answer: You can order via WhatsApp at +91 93457 34680, call us directly, or fill out our online order form. Just let us know which cake you'd like, the weight, delivery date, and any special requirements!

faqs.question: How much advance notice do you need for an order?
faqs.answer: We recommend ordering at least 24 hours in advance to ensure availability. For custom or specialty cakes, please order 2-3 days ahead. However, we do accept same-day orders subject to availability - just call us!

faqs.question: What is your minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: Our minimum order is 0.5 KG (half kg) for all cakes. We also offer 1 KG and 2 KG sizes for most cakes.

faqs.question: Do you deliver cakes? What areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: Yes! We deliver across Coimbatore city including RS Puram, Gandhipuram, Saibaba Colony, Peelamedu, Singanallur, and surrounding areas. Delivery charges may apply based on location.

faqs.question: Can I get same-day delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, same-day delivery is available for orders placed before 12 PM, subject to availability. Please call us to confirm before placing your order.

faqs.question: Is there a delivery charge?
faqs.answer: Delivery charges range from ₹50-₹100 depending on the distance from Ondipudur. Orders above ₹1500 may get free delivery - ask us!

faqs.question: Can I customize the cake design?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We love creating custom cakes based on your vision. Share your ideas, theme, colors, and any reference images. We'll work with you to create your dream cake!

faqs.question: Can you write a custom message on the cake?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can add any message you'd like on the cake at no extra charge. Just let us know the text when ordering.

faqs.question: Do you make eggless cakes?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can make eggless versions of most of our cakes! Please mention your requirement when ordering. Note that some specialty cakes like Tiramisu may have limited eggless options.

faqs.question: What ingredients do you use?
faqs.answer: We use only premium, fresh ingredients - real butter, fresh cream, quality chocolate, and fresh fruits. No artificial colors or preservatives. Everything is made from scratch!

faqs.question: Are your cakes suitable for people with allergies?
faqs.answer: Each cake listing shows common allergens (eggs, dairy, gluten, nuts). Please inform us of any specific allergies when ordering, and we'll do our best to accommodate or suggest suitable alternatives.

faqs.question: What are your cake prices?
faqs.answer: Prices vary by cake type and weight. Generally, cakes range from ₹350-₹650 for 0.5KG, ₹650-₹1200 for 1KG, and ₹1400-₹2300 for 2KG. Check individual cake pages for exact pricing or contact us!

faqs.question: Do custom cakes cost more?
faqs.answer: Custom designs may have additional charges depending on complexity. Simple message and color customizations are free. For elaborate designs, we'll provide a quote after discussing your requirements.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept cash on delivery, UPI payments (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), and bank transfers. Full or partial advance may be required for large or custom orders.

faqs.question: How long do your cakes stay fresh?
faqs.answer: Our cakes are best consumed within 24 hours of delivery for optimal taste and freshness. They can be refrigerated and will stay fresh for up to 2-3 days.

faqs.question: Can I pick up my order instead of delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can pick up your order from our location in Ondipudur. This saves delivery charges too. Just let us know your preferred pickup time when ordering.

faqs.question: Do you cater for large events?
faqs.answer: Yes! We handle orders for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, and corporate events. For large orders (multiple cakes or serving 50+ people), please contact us at least a week in advance.

faqs.question: What makes Sabu Cakes special?
faqs.answer: Every cake is freshly baked to order by Sabarika herself - no mass production! We use premium ingredients, offer unique Indian fusion flavors, and put love into every creation. You're getting truly homemade quality!
